nodes.description: Owner address of the contract; written by constructor, transferOwnership and renounceOwnership.
Mapping of role => RoleData used for role based access control.
Token balance mapping updated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping updated by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Threshold below which the burn-on-transfer fee is disabled.
Burn percentage applied on every transfer while supply is above the minimum.
Privileged LP address; transfers/transferFrom to this address are silently rejected.
Token decimals set in the constructor and by _setupDecimals.
Monotonic counter of the last snapshot id created by _snapshot.
Deploys the token, mints the initial supply to the deployer and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and SNAPSHOT_ROLE to the deployer.
Public transfer; returns false and performs no transfer when recipient equals the privileged _lp address.
Public transferFrom; returns false and performs no transfer when recipient equals the privileged _lp address.
Sets the caller allowance for a spender via _approve.
Internal transfer that computes and burns a BURN_RATE fee before moving the remaining amount.
Internal mint increasing total supply and account balance.
Internal burn decreasing account balance and total supply.
Admin-only setter that writes the privileged _lp address used to block transfers.
Grants a role; guarded by the role admin check on _msgSender().
Revokes a role; guarded by the role admin check on _msgSender().
Unconditionally grants a role without any caller check; intended for the constructor only.
Role-guarded function that creates a balance/total-supply snapshot.
Burns tokens from the caller via _burn.
Burns tokens from an account using the caller allowance via _burn.
Atomically increases an allowance by addedValue.
Atomically decreases an allowance by subtractedValue.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership to a new address.
Owner-only renunciation of ownership, setting _owner to zero.
Sends wei to a recipient using a low-level call forwarding all available gas.
Performs an arbitrary low-level call with value and bubbles up revert data.
Caller-supplied address used as transfer source, allowance owner and role holder.
Conditional guard that silently returns false and skips _transfer whenever recipient == _lp, giving the admin an effective transfer blacklist.
Low-level call transferring control and all remaining gas to an arbitrary recipient, enabling reentrancy.
Burn amount computed as amount * BURN_RATE / PERCENTS_DIVIDER and subtracted from the transfer amount before balances are updated.
Recipient parameter of transfer, compared against _lp.
Amount parameter of transfer forwarded to _transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom, compared against _lp.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used for the transfer and allowance deduction.
Local holding the amount left after the burn fee is deducted.
Local holding the computed burn fee.
Source address parameter of the internal _transfer.
Destination address parameter of the internal _transfer.
Value parameter of the internal _transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source of the token transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
Deployer msg.sender receives the minted supply and all initial roles.
setLP validates the caller role against msg.sender.
grantRole requires the admin role for msg.sender.
revokeRole requires the admin role for msg.sender.
snapshot requires SNAPSHOT_ROLE for msg.sender.
burnFrom deducts the allowance of msg.sender.
transfer reads _lp to decide whether the transfer is silently blocked.
transferFrom reads _lp to decide whether the transfer is silently blocked.
setLP lets the admin choose the privileged address that can never receive tokens.
transfer evaluates the recipient == _lp guard.
transferFrom evaluates the recipient == _lp guard.
_transfer is only reached when the _lp guard passes.
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the state change to _transfer.
_transfer calls _burn to apply the transfer burn fee.
constructor mints the initial supply.
constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and SNAPSHOT_ROLE without checks.
burn calls _burn.
burnFrom calls _burn.
grantRole mutates the role mapping.
revokeRole mutates the role mapping.
_setupRole writes the role mapping without caller validation.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes the owner state variable.
_transfer reads and writes the balance mapping.
_transfer reads total supply to decide whether to burn.
_transfer reads the minimum supply threshold.
_transfer reads BURN_RATE to compute the fee.
_transfer performs mul/div/sub arithmetic on user-controlled amounts.
the burn computation produces the remainingAmount local.
the burn computation produces the burnAmount local.
_burn writes the balance mapping.
_burn writes the total supply.
_mint writes the balance mapping.
_mint writes the total supply.
snapshot increments the snapshot counter.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
increaseAllowance writes the allowance mapping.
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance mapping.
sendValue performs a value-bearing low-level call that hands control to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call that can re-enter the caller.
transfer binds the recipient parameter.
transfer binds the amount parameter.
transferFrom binds the sender parameter.
transferFrom binds the recipient parameter.
transferFrom binds the amount parameter.
_transfer binds the source parameter.
_transfer binds the destination parameter.
_transfer binds the value parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter belongs to the transfer function and only participates in the _lp guard.
Amount parameter is only forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
Sender parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is only used for the _lp guard inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is only used for the transfer and allowance deduction inside transferFrom.
Local remaining amount exists only as the intermediate result of the burn computation.
Local burn amount exists only as the output of the burn fee arithmetic.
Source parameter is consumed directly by the internal transfer logic.
Destination parameter is consumed directly by the internal transfer logic.
Value parameter is consumed directly by the internal transfer logic.
